ev.q: During 2007–2014, the prevalence of hypertension was 23.1% among adults in Los Angeles County, lower than the prevalence of 29.6% among all U.S. adults.
substantial improvements from 1999–2006 to 2007–2014 were found in hypertension awareness (increase from 73.8% to 84.6%)
During 2007–2014, the prevalence of hypertension was 23.1% among adults in Los Angeles County, lower than the prevalence of 29.6% among all U.S. adults.
Levels of awareness, treatment, and control of hypertension were similar in Los Angeles County and the United States
Hypertension prevalence estimates were age-adjusted by the direct method to the 2000 U.S. Census population
NHANES is a cross-sectional survey designed to monitor the health and nutritional status
from 1999–2006 to 2007–2014, awareness increased from 73.8% to 84.6%
Healthy People 2020 goal for control of hypertension has not been met

methods_quotes.q: Standard errors of prevalences were estimated using Taylor series linearization
95% confidence intervals were constructed using Korn and Graubard's method for use with small expected positive counts
were evaluated by examining p-values calculated using a univariate two-sided t-statistic
with the combined standard error accounting for the correlation between Los Angeles County and the United States
No adjustments were made for multiple comparisons.
